scoring_justification: The checker independently recomputes the expected bulk moduli from the formula and end-member constants, then compares each value in the agent CSV within an absolute tolerance. This yields a verifiable, repeatable score without trusting the agent's self-report.

outputs.description: Computed isothermal bulk modulus for each of the nine CaF2–SrF2 compositions. The row order must match CaF2 (0% Sr) to SrF2 (100% Sr).

output_contract.notes: The verifier recomputes the expected bulk modulus for each composition using the same formula and constants; each value is compared with an absolute tolerance. The reward is the fraction of values within tolerance.
